newsitem.title: JAPAN: Lehman to cut cut Japan staff -- sources.
newsitem.headline: Lehman to cut cut Japan staff -- sources.

text.p: Lehman Brothers will make steep job cuts in some areas including Japanese stocks sales and research, sources close to the company said on Friday.

A spokesman for Lehman Brothers in Tokyo declined to comment on the number of staff it plans to reduce in Tokyo or on whether a reshuffling of staff would result in an overall staff reduction in its Japanese operation.
Lehman said on Thursday it would reorganise its Japanese operations, a move that would include a reduction of staff numbers in certain areas of Lehman Brothers Japan. It did not specify the areas.
Lehman also said in a statement that it would aim in Japan to strengthen higher-margin activities in capital markets and investment-banking businesses.
The sources said the sales force involved in Japanese securities would be slashed by 90 percent while the research division would be halved from its current levels.
